notes: Being forced to speak Spanish all the time was the best thing for improving my vocabulary because I was learning everything on a "need to know basis". I didn't get around to making note cards for practicing my Spanish until the end of the week and time needed for homework has taken me away from being able to practice my vocabulary more. However, all of my teachers and companeros have been extremely patient with me while I learn my new language. In order to get more out of the co-curriculars, it would have been really great to have a list of basic vocabulary of the activity before engaging in it. For example, "fuera" y "el dentro" for volleyball.
